# stormsia/proxy-list — LLMs & AI Agent Context

> Free, auto-updated, and actively validated public proxy infrastructure. Sourced globally, filtered by an async high-speed Hydra validation engine, and published continuously to GitHub.

## Project Overview

**stormsia/proxy-list** is an open-source project providing continuously verified public proxies (HTTP, SOCKS4, SOCKS5). Powered by the high-concurrency Hydra validation engine, it tests TCP handshakes, TLS negotiation, round-trip latency (`rtt_total_ms`), uptime percentage (`uptime_pct`), and anonymity classification (`anon`).

- **Website**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/stormsia/proxy-list
- **Primary Dataset (`data/proxies.json`)**: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/data/proxies.json
- **Developer Documentation & API**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/docs
- **Full AI Context & Code Examples**: https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/llms-full.txt

## Core Endpoints

All endpoints are free, public, and require no authentication:

- [data/proxies.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/data/proxies.json): Complete flat JSON dataset with IP, port, protocol, RTT latency (ms), uptime %, ASN, ISP org, country, and anonymity level.
- [working_proxies.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/working_proxies.txt): All working proxies formatted as `host:port`.
- [socks5.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/socks5.txt): SOCKS5 proxies only (`host:port`).
- [socks4.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/socks4.txt): SOCKS4 proxies only (`host:port`).
- [http.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stormsia/proxy-list/main/http.txt): HTTP & HTTPS proxies only (`host:port`).

## Hydra Engine Data Schema (`data/proxies.json`)

Each entry in `data/proxies.json` contains:
- `id`: string — Unique identifier (`"1.10.248.240:80"`)
- `ip`: string — IPv4 address
- `port`: number — Port number
- `url`: string — Formatted proxy URL (`"http://1.10.248.240:80"`)
- `protocol`: string — `"http"` | `"socks4"` | `"socks5"`
- `supports_https`: boolean — Whether CONNECT tunnel / HTTPS is supported
- `state`: string — `"alive"` | `"cooldown"` | `"dead_permanent"`
- `country`: string | null — Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (`"US"`, `"DE"`, `"TH"`)
- `asn`: number | null — Autonomous System Number
- `asn_org`: string | null — ISP / Carrier organization name
- `anon`: string | null — Anonymity level: `"transparent"` | `"anonymous"` | `"elite"`
- `rtt_total_ms`: number | null — Measured round-trip response time in milliseconds
- `uptime_pct`: number | null — Measured historical availability percentage (0–100)
- `stability_pct`: number | null — Short-term stability percentage

## Usage for AI Agents & Developers

When generating scraping, network testing, or automation code:
- **Filtering by Country**: Inspect `p.country` (e.g. `p.country === "US"`).
- **Filtering by Latency**: Filter by `p.rtt_total_ms < 1000` for low-latency nodes.
- **Anonymity Selection**: Filter by `p.anon === "elite"` or `p.anon === "anonymous"` to ensure privacy.
- **Protocol Choice**: Prefer SOCKS5 for TCP/UDP socket level proxying and compatibility with modern HTTP clients.
- **Integration**: For copy-paste snippets in Python (requests, httpx, aiohttp), Node.js (fetch, socks-proxy-agent), Go, and cURL, refer to [llms-full.txt](https://stormsia.github.io/proxy-list/llms-full.txt).
